Despite headlines suggesting otherwise, General Motors (GM) has not changed its stance on CarPlay and Android Auto support. The automaker will not restore phone projection support on any models that have already had the feature removed. The truth is exactly that.

GM has not reversed its decision to abandon CarPlay

The misunderstanding began with the new software experience GM announced last week for its Chevrolet Silverado and GMC Sierra trucks. The company heavily promoted a brand-new picture-in-picture phone mirroring system, claiming that CarPlay and Android Auto would coexist alongside GM's own infotainment system.

Some sources interpreted this news as GM backing down from its plan to abandon CarPlay—a plan first announced back in 2023. Unfortunately, that is not the case. GM's original announcement was to remove CarPlay support from its future electric vehicles, and it has followed through, with the Cadillac Lyriq EV being the only exception.

GM has not removed CarPlay or Android Auto from any of its gasoline vehicles. Therefore, the new phone projection system on the Chevrolet Silverado and GMC Sierra trucks does not represent the automaker caving to pressure and restoring CarPlay support on its EVs.

A GM spokesperson confirmed this to Joanna Stern, who posted the following on X today:

The misunderstanding is understandable. GM CEO Mary Barra previously stated in an interview that the automaker would remove CarPlay and Android Auto from gasoline vehicles at some point. However, the company quickly clarified that gasoline vehicles would continue to offer phone projection for the "foreseeable future."

In short, nothing has changed. GM has not restored CarPlay on its electric vehicles. The company's strategy remains unchanged. One could perhaps interpret GM offering a picture-in-picture solution for some gasoline vehicles as a sign that it recognizes how unpopular the move to drop it has been. But I think that would be too generous a reading.

P.S. John Gruber wins the award in my mind for the best headline on this story.
